hints: Two neighbouring windows share all but two readings. What actually changes when the window slides one place right?
Keep a running total instead of re-adding the whole window: sliding right adds the reading that enters and removes the one that leaves.
Sum the first window directly, then slide across the rest updating that total in constant time per step.

total += values[start + width - 1] - values[start - 1]. Track the best total and where it started, and update only when the new total is strictly larger - that is what keeps the earlier index on a tie.
